mapper.sql: CASE WHEN q.status = 10 AND q.valid_until < CURDATE() THEN 30 ELSE q.status END
mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.quotation_no, q.customer_id, q.quote_date, q.valid_until, q.discount_rate, q.status AS raw_status, AS status, q.order_id, q.order_no, q.submit_time, q.void_time, q.remark, q.create_time, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name FROM sal_quotation q LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = q.customer_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.deleted = 0

SELECT i.id, i.quotation_id, i.material_id, i.qty, i.price, i.cost_price, i.amount, i.remark, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec FROM sal_quotation_item i LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_quotation SET status = 10, submit_by = #{operator}, submit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sal_quotation SET status = 40, void_by = #{operator}, void_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 10) AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sal_quotation SET status = 20, order_id = #{orderId}, order_no = #{orderNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 10 AND valid_until >= CURDATE() AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, ref_cost FROM base_material WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{mid}
SELECT name FROM base_material WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM base_warehouse WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT n.id, n.notice_no, n.order_id, n.order_no, n.customer_id, n.warehouse_id, n.plan_date, n.status, n.notify_time, n.cancel_time, n.settle_time, n.remark, n.create_time, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = n.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS total_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.out_qty), 0) FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = n.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS total_out_qty FROM sal_delivery_notice n LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = n.customer_id LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = n.warehouse_id WHERE n.deleted = 0
AND (n.notice_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND n.status = #{status}
ORDER BY n.id DESC

SELECT n.id, n.notice_no, n.order_id, n.order_no, n.customer_id, n.warehouse_id, n.plan_date, n.status, n.notify_time, n.cancel_time, n.settle_time, n.remark, n.create_time, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = n.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS total_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.out_qty), 0) FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = n.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS total_out_qty FROM sal_delivery_notice n LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = n.customer_id LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = n.warehouse_id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted = 0

SELECT i.id, i.notice_id, i.order_detail_id, i.material_id, i.qty, i.out_qty, i.remark, (i.qty - i.out_qty) AS remaining_qty, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_delivery_notice SET status = 10, notify_by = #{operator}, notify_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0

UPDATE sal_delivery_notice SET status = 30, cancel_by = #{operator}, cancel_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 10) AND deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.out_qty > 0 )
UPDATE sal_delivery_notice_item SET out_qty = out_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND deleted = 0 AND out_qty + #{qty} <= qty

UPDATE sal_delivery_notice SET status = 20, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 10 AND deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i WHERE i.notice_id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.out_qty < i.qty )
UPDATE sal_delivery_notice SET settle_by = #{operator}, settle_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM sal_delivery_notice_item i JOIN sal_delivery_notice n ON n.id = i.notice_id AND n.deleted = 0 WHERE i.order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND n.status IN (0, 10)
AND i.notice_id != #{excludeNoticeId}
SELECT id, out_no, order_id, order_no, customer_id, warehouse_id, status FROM sal_outstock WHERE out_no = #{outNo} AND deleted = 0

SELECT d.order_detail_id, d.material_id, SUM(d.qty) AS qty FROM sal_outstock_detail d JOIN sal_outstock o ON o.id = d.out_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE o.out_no = #{outNo} AND d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.order_detail_id, d.material_id

SELECT s.material_id, s.warehouse_id, SUM(s.qty) AS available_qty, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY s.material_id, s.warehouse_id, m.code, m.name, m.spec, w.name ORDER BY m.code, w.name
